items.title: Qwen 3.8 27b just feels… ok?
items.summary: I’ve seen posts here raving about how good Qwen 3.8 27b is. The benchmarks look incredible, and all the online discourse seems to deem it the best local model. I have 32GB VRAM and run Unsloth’s Q6 version with OpenCode. For small tasks, it feels fine. I range 30-40 t/s decode and smaller sized tasks do finish, usually, without much issue or time.
